Statement of Changes in Equity

The Statement of Changes in Equity form configures equity movement reports.

Set date ranges to analyze changes in capital and retained earnings.

Title

Enter a custom title for the report, or leave blank to use the default title.

Description

Add an optional description or subtitle that will appear under the report title.

Accounting method

Select whether to use accrual or cash basis accounting for this report.

Rounding

Select how amounts should be rounded in the report.

Periods

Add one or more periods to compare equity changes across different time frames.

Exclude zero balances

Check to exclude equity accounts with no changes from the report.

Footer

Enter any footer text to appear at the bottom of the report.
